title: ai.qory.run.policy_applied
description: The policy the run is pinned to, as read once before the runtime started, and the effective allow list after the declared egress narrowed it.

allow.description: The effective allow list: the policy's entries, or when a declaration was given, the declared entries the policy covers.

source.description: config when a policy document was given to the runner; none when there was none and the runner observes everything.

digest.description: sha256 of the policy document as canonical JSON, hex, when source is config: the version stamp of the run's policy, the same for the same policy however it was written.

paths.description: The policy's path rules, by host, when it has any.

credentials.description: The credentials the run holds outside the enclosure, as resolved before the runtime started: where each goes and how. Never a token.

terminated.description: The hosts the proxy terminates TLS for in this run: the ones a credential is for and the ones with path rules. Every other host is a tunnel the proxy does not read.

declared.description: The egress the harness declared, as handed to the runner, when it was.
